description: This file defines an ESLint plugin rule to warn about the use of literal colors in code, encouraging the use of theme color variables instead.

methods.name: hasHexColor
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a hexadecimal color code.

methods.name: hasRgbColor
methods.description: Checks if a string contains an RGB or RGBA color code.

methods.name: hasLiteralColor
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a literal color keyword, optionally strict.
